content: Calibre's Qt5→Qt6 migration (Calibre 6+) requires plugin devs to use fully-qualified enum names since compatibility shims exist only for the most common enums; kiwidude's themed-icon-loading pattern breaks and needs adjustment; 32-bit support dropped because Qt6 drops it. PyQt5 imports are auto-redirected to PyQt6 under Calibre 6+, so import statements don't need to change, but enum usage (e.g. Qt.AlignCenter vs Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter) does.
